name: Magdala

identification.note: Home town of Mary Magdalene, whose epithet identifies her by this town.

related_people.name: Mary Magdalene
related_people.role: the town's daughter, freed by Jesus from seven demons and first witness of the resurrection

description: A fishing town on the Sea of Galilee, home of Mary Magdalene, from whom Jesus cast out seven demons and who later became a witness to His resurrection (Luke 8:2; John 20:11-18).
family_friendly_summary: Magdala was a fishing town on the Sea of Galilee and the home of Mary Magdalene. Jesus freed her from seven demons, and she became one of His most faithful followers — one of the very first people to see Him alive again after the resurrection.
